directAnswer: To take a screenshot on an iPhone, press the Side button and the Volume Up button at the same time, then quickly release them.
summary: Taking a screenshot on an iPhone is quick and easy, involving a combination of button presses.

sections.heading: Screenshot Methods
sections.body: There are different methods for taking screenshots depending on the iPhone model. Most models use the Side and Volume Up buttons, while older models with a Home button use the Home and Side buttons.

sections.heading: Viewing Your Screenshots
sections.body: After taking a screenshot, a thumbnail appears in the bottom left corner. Tap it to edit or share, or swipe left to dismiss it. Screenshots are saved in the Photos app under 'Albums' > 'Screenshots'.

steps.title: For iPhones with Face ID
steps.detail: Press the Side button and the Volume Up button simultaneously, then quickly release them.

steps.title: For iPhones with a Home Button
steps.detail: Press the Home button and the Side button (or Top button) at the same time, then quickly release.

steps.title: Accessing Your Screenshot
steps.detail: Open the Photos app, go to 'Albums', and select 'Screenshots' to view your captured images.

faqs.question: Can I take a screenshot using AssistiveTouch?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can enable AssistiveTouch in Settings > Accessibility > Touch > AssistiveTouch, then customize the menu to include a screenshot option.

faqs.question: How do I edit a screenshot after taking it?
faqs.answer: Tap the thumbnail that appears after taking the screenshot to access editing tools, such as cropping or drawing.

faqs.question: Where are my screenshots saved?
faqs.answer: Screenshots are saved in the Photos app under 'Albums' > 'Screenshots'.

caveats: The button combination may vary slightly depending on the model of your iPhone.
